data.name: Malika
data.long_meaning: Malika is an Arabic name that means 'queen' or 'ruler'. It symbolizes power, authority, and leadership. In Islamic tradition, it is a name that signifies strength and dignity.

in_arabic.name: ملكة
in_arabic.meaning: ملكة تعني الحاكمة أو صاحبة الجلالة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ملكة مشتق من الجذر اللغوي م-ل-ك، ويعني الحاكمة أو صاحبة الجلالة. ورد اسم ملكة في القرآن الكريم، ويستخدم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كاسم للبنات، ملكة هو اسم يدل على القوة والسلطة والنفوذ.

in_urdu.name: ملکہ
in_urdu.meaning: ملکہ کا مطلب ہے حکمران یا شہنشاہی
in_urdu.long_meaning: ملکہ نام عربی زبان کی root م-ل-ك سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں حکمران یا شہنشاہی۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں ذکر ہوا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافتوں میں لڑکیوں کے لئے ایک مقبول نام ہے۔ ملکہ نام طاقت، سلطنت اور اثر و رسوخ کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मलिका
in_hindi.meaning: मलिका का अर्थ है शासिका या रानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: मलिका नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा के मूल म-ल-क से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है शासिका या रानी। यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लेखित है और इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में लड़कियों के लिए एक लोकप्रिय नाम है। मलिका नाम शक्ति, शासन और प्रभाव की प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: ملکه
in_pashto.meaning: ملکه د حاکمې یا شہنشاهۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: ملکه نوم د عربي ژبې د م-ل-ك ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د حاكمې یا شہنشاهۍ. دا نوم په قرآن كريم كې ذكر شوی او په اسلامي كلتورونو كې د انجونو لپاره يو مشهور نوم دی. ملکه نوم د ځواک، سلطنت او اغېزمنۍ نښه ده.

in_english.name: Malika
in_english.meaning: Malika means ruler, queen, or a person of authority
in_english.long_meaning: The name Malika is derived from the Arabic root م-ل-ك (m-l-k), which means ruler, queen, or a person of authority. This name is mentioned in the Quran and is a popular choice for girls in many Islamic cultures. Malika signifies strength, sovereignty, and influence, reflecting positive attributes such as leadership and charisma.

data.cultural_impact: The name Malika is admired in Arab and Islamic culture for its strong female connotations. It is a name that conveys a sense of powerful leadership, elegance, and grace. Malika is a name that has been given to many notable and influential women in Islamic history, such as Al-Malika Al-Adilah, known as Queen Arwa of Yemen, and Malika al-Qadis, a famous poet and scholar (1076 A.D.). The name Malika is also popular in contemporary Islamic societies, as it represents the empowerment of women and their role as leaders, both in the personal and public spheres.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Malika is rooted in its Arabic origins and the rich Islamic tradition. Malika is a reminder of the belief in the Oneness of God and the ultimate power and sovereignty (malakut) of Allah. At the same time, it encourages individuals to strive for personal growth and leadership, as an expression of their inner spiritual call to serve and rule with compassion and wisdom. In Islamic spirituality, the idea of Malika represents the idea of the caring and nurturing mother, who rules over her domain with love, care, and mercy, reflecting the universal divine qualities of Mercy and Compassion. Ultimately, the name Malika serves as a reminder of the deeper spiritual realities of power, leadership, and service in the journey of life.
